texts: One script tag puts a 3D avatar assistant in the corner of any site. Pick a body, a background, and what it knows about your page. three.ws/assistant
The live preview runs in the corner of the page while you configure it, and every change above re-mounts it.
Use a built-in body, any three.ws avatar id, a GLB URL, or an agent's body. It answers in chat, or speaks what you type in a speech bubble.

issues.quote: It answers in chat, or speaks what you type in a speech bubble.
issues.problem: The 'answers in chat' half is vague about where answers come from; the live page names a free model chain (Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA), which is a stronger, checkable mechanism.
issues.fix: Optional: 'It answers in chat from a free model chain, or speaks what you type out loud in a speech bubble.' Do not sacrifice length or clarity to force it.

issues.problem: The house contract says every post ships an image; only post 1 carries the frame. For a thread the single hero image on the lead is standard practice, but the rule is stated absolutely.
issues.fix: Accept as is for a thread, or explicitly annotate the pack that media attaches to post 1 only.
